name: Serge Birault
description: Serge Birault , also known as PapaNinja , is a French digital illustrator celebrated for his bold, pin-up inspired artworks. Blending influences from manga, comics, and classic art, his style is instantly recognizable—often featuring strong, stylized female characters in surreal or humorous settings. Originally from Toulouse, Birault has worked as a senior concept artist at Respawn Entertainment and published acclaimed artbooks like Corpus Delicti and Gürlz . His work combines technical precision with playful irreverence, earning him a loyal following across the digital art world. Showcase images were created with ComfyUI and are in PNG, include metadata & workflow. All licensing conditions for the Flux Dev model apply. You can find the details here . IMPORTANT NOTE : This model is a tribute to the artist and not an attempt to copy or reproduce his works. Flux1.D is unable to reproduce a graphic universe on which it was trained, the goal is solely to expand Flux's pictorial capabilities.
